tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_illusory_orb_D:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.\n\n At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.

Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_puck_bio: While Puck seems at first glance a mischievous, childish character, this quality masks an alien personality. The juvenile form of a Faerie Dragon, a creature that lives for eons, Puck spends countless millennia in its childish form. So while it is technically true that Puck is juvenile, it will continue to be so when the cities of the present age have sloughed away into dust. Its motives are therefore inscrutable, and what appears to be play may in fact hide a darker purpose. Its endless fondness for mischief is the true indicator of Puck's true nature.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_puck_hype: Puck has a talent for confounding its enemies with playfully elusive mischief. By teleporting to its damaging orb in order to hop short distances, it attacks foes with bursts of silencing dust. By the time its enemies can react, Puck has long since escaped.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_puck_npedesc1: Orbs to enemies and silences them

Its motives are therefore inscrutable, and what appears to be play may in fact hide a darker purpose. Its endless fondness for mischief is the true indicator of Puck's true nature.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-2.png|84px]]
** Can affect enemy heroes at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Dream Coil cast range}}+{{#var:Dream Coil value1}}}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and latch radius.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** The ability effects are applied as follows upon breaking the {{M|leash}}:
**# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
**# The {{M|stun}} {{M|debuff}}.

* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|coiled}}
** Applies a leash debuff on all affected enemy heroes within the latch radius upon cast.
*** Considers {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.
** The coil duration is not affected by {{M|status resistance}} sources.
** Multiple overlapping Dream Coil instance fully stack, with each leash duration independent of the other.
** Affects the following units:
*** {{M|Fogged units}}.
*** {{M|Invisible}} units.
** However, it still does not grant {{M|vision}} over these units. The link visually appears to their last know location.
* [[File:Dota2 Link Break icon.png|21px|Link Break Properties]]
** Dream Coil applies its link break ability effects whenever the leashed enemy hero moves beyond the link break distance.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Adds a passive component to Dream Coil.
** {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}}
*** [[Instant attacks]] enemy heroes with the following debuffs, regardless of distance:
**** {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|coiled}}
**** {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|coiled_break_stun}}
*** Has the following properties:
**** Only instant attack Dream Coil-affected enemy heroes from Puck's applied debuff instance.
**** Procs {{M|attack modifiers}} and {{M|on-cast effects}} as per normal, including the {{Symbol|bonus shd}} {{A|Puck|Phase Shift}} {{M|magical}} {{M|bonus attack damage}}.
**** Does not have {{M|True Strike}}.
**** Not affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.
**** {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}}
***** Although the attack projectiles originate from the Dream Coil's center, the damage is still sourced to Puck.
***** Does not require Puck to be within the Dream Coil radius to instant attack enemy heroes.
*** The instant attack interval is defined as:
**** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|DmgInt {{=}} (100 × {{Show|H|Puck|bat}}) / ([[Attack Speed|ΣAS]] × {{#var:Dream Coil type3 value2 agh}}) + 1 [[Server Tick|ServerTick]]}}
**** With the {{M|attack speed}} limits, the min and max possible damage intervals are as follows:
***** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|MIN {{=}} {{#expr:(100*{{Show|H|Puck|bat}})/({{#var:Dream Coil type3 value2 agh}}*{{G|attack speed max}}) round3}} + {{#expr:{{G|tick rate}} round3}}}}
***** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|MAX {{=}} {{#expr:(100*{{Show|H|Puck|bat}})/({{#var:Dream Coil type3 value2 agh}}*{{G|attack speed min}}) round3}} + {{#expr:{{G|tick rate}} round3}}}}
*** Checks for Puck's current attack speed per damage instance, then updates the damage intervals.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_puck
data.bio_loc: While Puck seems at first glance a mischievous, childish character, this quality masks an alien personality. The juvenile form of a Faerie Dragon, a creature that lives for eons, Puck spends countless millennia in its childish form. So while it is technically true that Puck is juvenile, it will continue to be so when the cities of the present age have sloughed away into dust. Its motives are therefore inscrutable, and what appears to be play may in fact hide a darker purpose. Its endless fondness for mischief is the true indicator of Puck's true nature.
data.hype_loc: Puck has a talent for confounding its enemies with playfully elusive mischief. By teleporting to its damaging orb in order to hop short distances, it attacks foes with bursts of silencing dust. By the time its enemies can react, Puck has long since escaped.
data.npe_desc_loc: Orbs to enemies and silences them

abilities.name: puck_illusory_orb
abilities.desc_loc:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed. At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
abilities.lore_loc: The playful Faerie Dragon delights in confusing others, vanishing and reappearing where unexpected.
notes_loc: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.

abilities.desc_loc: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
abilities.lore_loc: With a mischievous grin, Puck spreads its enchanted powder which disrupts magical flow.
facets_loc: Waning Rift pushes enemies away. If the ability is in alt-cast state, it will pull them instead.

abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
abilities.lore_loc: With a quip and flash, Puck returns to the alien dimension from whence it came.
notes_loc: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.
abilities.shard_loc: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.

abilities.desc_loc: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores %mana_and_health_restore_pct%%% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores %dodged_spell_multiplier%x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

abilities.desc_loc: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
